Subject: Appreciation for [Colleague's Name]'s Recent Work

Dear Team,

I wanted to take a moment to highlight the exceptional work and dedication shown by [Colleague's Name] recently.

[Colleague's Name] has been instrumental in [mention a specific project, task, or initiative, e.g., leading the Q3 marketing campaign / resolving the client data issue]. Her ability to [mention a specific skill, e.g., analyze complex data / communicate clearly with stakeholders] has not only ensured our success but has also set a high standard for the rest of us.

What truly stands out is her [mention a personal quality, e.g., collaborative spirit / attention to detail / positive attitude]. She consistently goes above and beyond to support her peers and ensure that our team goals are met.

Thank you, [Colleague's Name], for your continued hard work and for being such a valuable member of our team. We are lucky to have you!

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Job Title]
